epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Claim amendment · 2026-10-29T23:34Z

The card thread measured the card's premise on `origin/main` (21c4bdd8). "ADR-0143 D4's per-dispatch resolver" does not exist yet: `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema` is still `none | bearer | api-key | basic`, and `connector-credentials.ts` has only `resolveConnectorCredential` (env → `sys_connector_credential` → vault, static kinds). D4 is #26702 items 2–4, still open. The scope is narrowed to match.

- Seam contract: lives in `@objectstack/types`. `service-datasource` and `service-automation` already depend on it, and an out-of-repo plugin driver can too. `service-automation` registers a kernel service (`connector-credential-source`); `service-datasource` looks it up. No new dependency edge among `objectql`, `service-datasource` and `service-automation`, and no `packages/spec/src/**` edit in this PR.
- Per-dispatch from day one: a handle bound to one connector instance. `get({ organizationId })` returns the resolved auth (bearer / api-key / basic, optional `expiresAt`), and `refresh()` serves the 401 path. A `@objectstack/types` helper runs a call with it: refresh on expiry, refresh and retry once on 401, then the floor's 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
- `service-automation` answers the static kinds through the existing chain, read on each call. #26702's `oauth2` plugs into the same handle later; the "refreshed after expiry" test uses a source double that mints expiring tokens.
- Connect: a datasource naming `external.connector` is refused fail-closed (failed-credentials) when no source is registered or the instance is undeclared. Runtime-origin datasources get the same check.
- File surface (replaces the claim's): `packages/types/src/**` (the seam contract and the call helper), `packages/services/service-datasource/src/**`, `packages/services/service-automation/src/**` (the provider and its registration), their tests, `.changeset/**`. `packages/objectql/src/**` is dropped. Stop on breach.
- `driver-odata` (#27741): unchanged from the claim. Whichever of #27741 / #27746 lands second wires `driver-odata` to the helper. The epic PM tells #27741's thread.

Clause-② stays `yes`.

The file surface (amendment 6511046968) adds `packages/spec/liveness/datasource.json`. The row #27783 added for `external.connector` as `planned` says to flip it to `live` with the connection-service anchor when this server card lands, in the same release. This PR flips it, with evidence in `datasource-connection-service.ts` (the borrow) and `service-automation` (the source), and re-records any generated count `check:liveness` asks for. It still makes no `packages/spec/src/**` edit.

Scope addition · 2026-10-30T00:15Z

One should-fix from the contract review of PR #27788 (record 6511604842) rides this card, because this card edits `datasource-connection-service.ts` next. The file surface is unchanged.

- [ ] `DatasourceConnectionService.reconnect`'s refusal for a missing `previous.driver` says a kept pool "would be restored" under a definition naming no driver. On the no-live-pool branch nothing is kept. Reword it to say this happens when a pool is live, and keep the guard first: the type already requires `previous`, and one rule per parameter is the point.
